title: trachyspermum copticum

It has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including the relief of digestive issues, such as bloating and gas, as well as its antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ajwain include its ability to ease respiratory issues like bronchitis and asthma, while its bioactive constituents, including volatile oils and flavonoids, contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, Ajwain has been used to alleviate menstrual cramps and other gynecological issues due to its uterine stimulant properties.
